lines.text: Four times the rain of Rioja.
lines.phonemes: fˈɔː tˈaɪmz ðə ɹˈeɪn ɒv ɹiˈɒxə.

lines.text: Nearly eighteen hundred millimetres at Vigo. Rioja gets four hundred.
lines.phonemes: nˌiəli ˈeɪtiːn hˈʌndɹɪd mˈɪlɪmˌiːtəz at vˈiːɡəʊ. ɹiˈɒxə ɡˈɛts fˈɔː hˈʌndɹɪd.

lines.text: Yet the sun is almost the same as in Rioja. About twenty-three hundred hours.
lines.phonemes: jˈɛt ðə sˈʌn ɪz ˈɔːlməʊst ðə sˈeɪm az ˈɪn ɹiˈɒxə. ɐbˌaʊt twˈɛntiθɹˈiː hˈʌndɹɪd ˈaʊəz.

lines.text: About two hundred forty metres. Rarely above three hundred.
lines.phonemes: ɐbˌaʊt tˈuː hˈʌndɹɪd fˈɔːti mˈiːtəz. ɹˈeəli əbˌʌv θɹˈiː hˈʌndɹɪd.

lines.text: Mostly granite. Sandy, acid, shallow soils.
lines.phonemes: mˈəʊstli ɡɹˈanɪt. sˈandi, ˈasɪd, ʃˈaləʊ sˈɔɪlz.

lines.text: April to October: sixteen point eight degrees on average.
lines.phonemes: ˈeɪpɹəl tʊ ɒktˈəʊbə: sˈɪkstiːn pˈɔɪnt ˈeɪt dɪɡɹˈiːz ˌɒn ˈavɹɪdʒ.

lines.text: Labelled Albariño? One hundred percent Albariño.
lines.phonemes: lˈeɪbəld ˌælbəɹˈiːnjəʊ ? wˈɒn hˈʌndɹɪd pəsˈɛnt ˌælbəɹˈiːnjəʊ.

lines.text: Test yourself. Three questions. Answers in the first comment.
lines.phonemes: tˈɛst jɔːsˈɛlf. θɹˈiː kwˈɛstʃənz. ˈansəz ɪnðə fˈɜːst kˈɒmɛnt.

lines.text: Study it free at open wine atlas dot com.
